public.text: Classification and clinical coding responsibilities — The existing example frames expertise around mappings “to” standards. Direct capture and correct classification use require additional named responsibilities.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace bullet: • Terminology, classification, and clinical coding specialists, who support direct implementation of standards such as ICD-11 and other WHO-FIC content; curate code systems and value sets; apply the relevant clinical coding and statistical rules; govern mappings where needed; and operate semantic governance processes with clinical and public-health users.
